title: When the Glasshouse Falls
author: Coral Crane
blurb: Beatrix Eriksen, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
